items.sentence: The MHRA says it has approved new versions of two Clenil Modulite beclometasone inhalers for the maintenance treatment of asthma in adults and children.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The new inhalers use a next-generation propellant, and the company says this is the first inhaler authorised with that propellant.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA describes the active ingredient as a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation in the airways.

items.sentence: It says the inhalers keep the same established treatment while reducing environmental impact.
